description: Use only after diagnose_issue when the caller wants a priced bounded repair. Creates a new non-binding quote for the selected or automatically matched public service. Repeating the call may create a different quoteId, so it is intentionally non-idempotent. It does not accept the quote, create checkout, send payment or start execution. If the quote is accepted by the caller, pass its quoteId and one offered payment rail to prepare_repair.

description.description: Sanitized bounded repair need derived from diagnose_issue; describe the failure and desired repair outcome without secrets or PII.

productId.description: Optional exact public productId suggested by diagnose_issue or chosen from the catalog. Omit to let NAIF match the closest service.

source.description: Optional attribution label for the calling agent or integration.

name: quote_repair

outputSchema.description: Non-binding repair quote. A successful result includes quoteId, price/currency, offered paymentRails and nextTool=prepare_repair. An error field indicates no quote was created.

automaticExecution.description: False; this tool never starts repair execution.

automaticJob.description: False; this tool never starts a repair job.

automaticPayment.description: False; this tool never sends or charges payment.

checkoutCreated.description: False; creating a quote does not create checkout.

error.description: Present when the requested service is unavailable or commerce could not create a quote.

eta.description: Estimated delivery time or service ETA when available.

exactAmount.description: Exact settlement amount when the selected payment design requires one; preserve it exactly as returned.

paymentRails.description: Payment rails offered for this quote; choose exactly one of these in prepare_repair.

price.description: Commercial price returned by the quote service.

quoteAccepted.description: False; creating a quote does not accept it.

quoteId.description: Unique non-binding quote identifier to pass to prepare_repair after explicit caller acceptance.

state.description: Current quote state returned by commerce.

title: Quote Repair
